Visiting Angels Fort Lee is a locally owned, family-operated elder care agency proudly serving Fort Lee, [Cliffside Park](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/home-care-cliffside-park-new-jersey), [Fairview](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/home-care-fairview-new-jersey), [North Bergen](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/home-care-north-bergen-new-jersey), [Guttenberg](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/home-care-guttenberg-new-jersey), [Leonia](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/home-care-leonia-new-jersey), and surrounding areas in [Bergen County, NJ](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/senior-home-care-bergen-county-nj). Since 2015, owners Michael Tucci and Stacey Lopis have remained actively involved in both the business and the local community, ensuring every family has direct access to leadership and support from people who truly understand their situation.

We provide dedicated home care solutions throughout the Snoqualmie Valley and surrounding communities. As one of the trusted [Visiting Angels locations](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/areas-we-serve-all), we make it easy for families to find quality support right in their neighborhood. If you are unsure whether your home falls within our local service area, please reach out to our office. We are happy to discuss care options near you.

We provide dependable, non-medical support tailored to the unique needs of each family. Our locally owned, family-run agency takes a personal, hands-on approach to helping your loved one remain comfortable at home. From personal care and companion care to transportation, medication reminders, and light housekeeping, we are available 24 hours a day to ensure seniors and families have professional assistance whenever it is needed.

Our 24 hour home care and [Overnight Care in Fort Lee](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/articles/overnight-care-fort-lee/28287) services provide dedicated nighttime support to help seniors stay safe, comfortable, and well cared for while they sleep. Caregivers assist with bedtime routines, mobility, bathroom needs, and fall prevention, while remaining alert throughout the night to respond when needed, giving families peace of mind that their loved one is never alone.

We provide specialized memory care for seniors with Alzheimer's, dementia, Parkinson's, or other memory-related conditions. Our [Alzheimer's care](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/alzheimers-services) and [dementia care services](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/dementia-care) offer companionship, supervision, and support with daily routines to help seniors feel safe, engaged, and comfortable in their own homes. Our caregivers provide cognitive stimulation, memory exercises, and dementia activities to enhance quality of life.
### Personal Care

Our [personal care services](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/private-duty-care) and private duty care include hands-on assistance with bathing, dressing, toileting, mobility, and daily hygiene, always respecting the senior's dignity. Our skilled caregivers provide bathing assistance, dressing assistance, grooming support, transfer assistance, ambulation help, and incontinence care with compassionate, dignified support. We also provide [companion care](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/elderly-companion-care) to ensure seniors stay socially engaged, emotionally supported, and mentally stimulated while receiving help with daily activities and light household tasks. Companion services include conversation, social outings, and activity engagement to prevent isolation.

Our [Ready-Set-Go Home service](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/ready-set-go-home) provides transitional care for adults returning home from hospital stays, outpatient procedures, or surgeries. We offer support with daily activities, reminders, and follow-up to ensure a smooth transition and prevent readmittance. Our caregivers provide rehabilitation support, physical therapy assistance, occupational therapy support, and stroke recovery care to facilitate healing and independence.

Our [24-hour home care in Fort Lee](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/articles/24-hour-care-at-home/28083) ensure seniors have consistent support at all times. Caregivers are available day and night, and [live-in home care in Fort Lee NJ](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/live-in-home-care-fort-lee-nj) can be arranged to provide continuous assistance, companionship, and help with daily routines. We also offer overnight care and immediate emergency care when urgent needs arise.
### Respite Care

Our [respite care services](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/respite-care) provide family caregivers with a break while we offer dependable, high-quality care for their loved ones. We provide temporary care with flexible scheduling, including same-day service and last minute care when family caregivers need immediate relief. We also provide [long distance care](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/long-distance-services) for families who live far away, keeping them informed and confident about their loved one's well-being.

Our [end-of-life care services](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/end-of-life-care) focus on comfort, dignity, and quality of life for seniors and their families. We also provide [palliative care](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/palliative-care), offering non-medical support that complements hospice or palliative programs. Our compassionate hospice support helps families navigate this difficult time with dignity and peace.
### Light Housekeeping
We help seniors maintain a clean and comfortable home with light housekeeping, laundry, dishwashing, and tidying tasks.
### Meal Preparation

All of our services are non-medical and completely designed to adapt over time. Our team remains available to families as a constant resource by answering questions, addressing concerns, and guiding next steps as care needs evolve. We help families assess exactly when to start in home care and evaluate whether traditional home nursing or personalized senior home care NJ options best meet their loved one's specific needs.

If you or someone you love needs home care in Fort Lee, NJ, contact Visiting Angels Fort Lee at [201-820-0764](tel:2018200764), or reach out through our [online contact form](https://www.visitingangels.com/fortlee/contact-us). We are here to talk through your options and help you decide on the next step for care at home. Our established agency has years of experience serving families throughout Bergen County, and we invite you to review our testimonials and references from satisfied clients.
